tool.name: GeneFior-Gene-Stats
tool.description: Generate gene-level coverage visualisations and read exports
tool.command:
mkdir -p input_dir/raw_outputs output_dir &&
#if $sec_raw_outputs.diamond_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.diamond_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_diamond_results.tsv' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.blastn_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.blastn_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_blastn_results.tsv' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.blastx_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.blastx_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_blastx_results.tsv' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.blastp_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.blastp_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_blastp_results.tsv' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.bowtie2_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.bowtie2_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_bowtie2_results_sorted.bam' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.bwa_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.bwa_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_bwa_results_sorted.bam' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.minimap2_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.minimap2_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_minimap2_results_sorted.bam' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.detection_matrix: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.detection_matrix' 'input_dir/user-provided-db_detection_matrix.tsv' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.evidence_matrix: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.evidence_matrix' 'input_dir/user-provided-db_evidence_matrix.tsv' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.run_parameters: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.run_parameters' 'input_dir/run_parameters.json' && #end if
GeneFior-gene-stats -i input_dir -o output_dir
#if str($genes): -g '$genes' #end if
--databases #echo ' '.join($databases)#
--tools #echo ' '.join($tools)#
#if str($gene_selection): --gene-selection '$gene_selection' #end if
#if $all_genes: --all-genes #end if
#if $ref_fasta: --ref-fasta '$ref_fasta' #end if
#if $query_fasta: --query-fasta '$query_fasta' #end if
$plot_per_tool $report_read_names $report_fasta --read-selection '$read_selection'
&& cd output_dir && zip -r '$results_archive' . && cd ..

param.label: Gene selection mode

param.label: Databases
param.help: Database(s) to interrogate

param.help: Plain-text reference FASTA file for variant calling (optional)

param.name: query_fasta

param.help: Original query FASTA/FASTQ file. Required for FASTA read export from BLAST/DIAMOND results

param.label: Generate per-tool plots
param.help: Generate individual per-tool coverage PNGs in addition to combined comparison plots

param.name: report_read_names

param.help: Write deduplicated read-name files for selected genes, databases, and tools

param.name: report_fasta
param.label: Report read FASTA
param.help: Write deduplicated read FASTA files for selected genes, databases, and tools

param.name: read_selection
param.label: Read selection
param.help: Which read-gene matches to export
param.option: Passing (only mappings passing original query thresholds)

tool.help:
@GENEFIOR_HELP@
**GeneFior-Gene-Stats** — Gene-level coverage visualisations
This tool generates detailed coverage visualisations and reports from GeneFíor results. Provide the raw alignment output files from a prior GeneFíor or AMRfior run (BLAST/DIAMOND TSVs and/or sorted BAM files), along with the detection and evidence matrices.
For each selected gene, database, and tool, it produces:
- **Coverage text reports** — Per-position depth, gap analysis, variant calling - **Coverage PNG plots** — Depth across the gene with variant markers *(per-tool plots require the "Generate per-tool plots" option)* - **Comparison reports** — Multi-tool agreement analysis - **Comparison PNG plots** — Coverage comparison across all tools
**Read export options:**
- **Report read names** — Write deduplicated read-name files per gene/tool/database - **Report read FASTA** — Write deduplicated read FASTA files. BLAST/DIAMOND exports require the original query FASTA to be provided.
